quote.quote: No Advisory Committee Meeting is planned for this application.
There was no Advisory Committee held related to this NDA submission.

This application was not taken before an advisory committee as tapentadol is not a "first-in-class" drug and there were no concerning safety signals; nor was there any concern regarding the data provided to support evidence of the product's efficacy.

no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not taken before an advisory committee as tapentadol is not a "first-in-class" drug and there were no concerning safety signals; nor was there any concern regarding the data provided to support evidence of the product's efficacy.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NUCYNTA (tapentadol, NDA022304). Three original review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical Review) all state no AC meeting was held or planned, because tapentadol is not a first-in-class drug, is a member of the previously approved opioid class, and raised no unexpected safety or efficacy concerns. With no committee meeting, there were no AC-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
